ns2:section.sectionText: First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery Courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet. LAS Global Studies Course. Students must also attend five events at 4-530 in Foellinger Auditorium on 9/8, 9/29, 10/20, 10/27, 11/17 in lieu of regular class meetings.
